Question: as salaam muftisaheb my wife has deliverd malechild on 7 july 2009 so please give me dua to make him heathy & strongh & make dua to me &my family & my child also allah hafeej. Answer ID: 14875 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1180/977=L/1430) Contact any expert hakim or doctor. Write down the below dua and get it hanged around his neck, he shall be protected against most of the troubles and evils, in-shaAllah: بسم اللہ الذ ي لا یضر مع اسمہ شئ في الأرض ولا في السماء وھو السمیع العلیم Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
